The '''''Sharmok''-class troop transport''', was a vessel designed and used sometime before [[44 ABY]]. It was used during the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] of the Jedi from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] by the [[New Jedi Order]] and [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. Several were stolen by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] in an attempt to assassinate [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]] and [[Chume'da]] [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] with [[Baradium/Legends|Baradium.]] However, the explosion went off early, and instead destroyed [[Volgh Squadron]].<ref name="FOTJA">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
